A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:SE-D-dagobah-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Dagobah (Dark) (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): The game text changes: “opponent's” becomes “opponent may not”; “drains” becomes “drain”; “locations are canceled.” becomes “locations.”. This is a full card image again (338 × 482 pixels), with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 E card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
